summary:
Trade press announcement (dated August 12, 2026) covering awards for the Pathmaker Table Series from Haskell Education at Best of NeoCon 2026. The product won in two categories: the Education Solutions jury awarded Silver, Business Impact, and People's Choice, while the Tables: Height-Adjustable jury awarded Silver and Innovation.

Positioning: Pathmaker is presented as the first truly ADA-compliant large-format table collection purpose-built for hands-on learning environments, designed around universal design (UD) principles so accessibility is integrated rather than added as a separate modification. The piece frames the problem: ADA and local codes require a share of classroom tables be wheelchair accessible, but most large-format tables are not height adjustable, and those that are often need one or two able-bodied people to adjust them, do not match surrounding furniture, and end up in a corner, leaving students isolated.

Features cited: height range of 29 in. to 42 in., cord-free battery power system offering days of adjustability per charge, self-controlled height adjustment, up to three ADA-compliant seating areas in the cantilevered design and up to four in the full table design, four top finishes (butcher block, stainless steel, solid surface, epoxy), full mobility, rounded corners, integrated top power, built-in storage, and an accompanying charging cart.

Specification context: STEM/STEAM labs, makerspaces, CTE classrooms and flex labs, including schools without budget for floor boxes that still want powered furniture.

Development and sustainability: three years of testing and development, responsibly sourced wood, low-VOC finishes, designed for longevity, repairability and refurbishment; energy-efficient production, renewable energy, water-based adhesives and finishes, waste reduction, and recycled raw materials.

Quotes come from Dr. Rosemarie Rossetti on UD reducing barriers to engagement, Education Wellness Consultant Anna Iversen on learner dignity, and NeoCon jurors, who also requested more leg options and a sleeker storage look.
